fields.description: ZPL (Zebra), EPL (older Zebra / Eltron), TSPL (TSC, Xprinter label printers) are sent raw to a label printer through QZ Tray. PDF prints a grid of labels on A4 sheets.
fields.label: Language

fields.description: Offered first for its language when the POS Profile has no default label template. One default per language.
fields.label: Default for this Language

fields.description: Leave empty to use this template with any company.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: For PDF: the width of one label on the sheet.
fields.label: Width (mm)

fields.description: For PDF: the height of one label on the sheet.
fields.label: Height (mm)

fields.description: Gap between labels on the roll.
fields.label: Gap (mm)

fields.description: EAN13 is used when the item's barcode is a valid EAN-13; other barcodes print as Code128.
fields.label: Barcode Type

fields.description: Space kept free inside each label. The grid of labels is centred on the sheet.
fields.label: Label Margin (mm)
Help
fields.options:
Values (escaped for the language): {{ item_name }}, {{ item_name_ar }}, {{ item_code }}, {{ barcode }}, {{ barcode_type }}, {{ uom }}, {{ price }} (incl. VAT), {{ price_label }} (AED 12.50), {{ currency }}, {{ company }}, {{ date }}, {{ weight }} (scale labels), {{ qty }} (labels to print), {{ width_mm }}, {{ height_mm }}, {{ width_dots }}, {{ height_dots }}, {{ gap_mm }}, {{ gap_dots }}, {{ dpi }}.

Helpers: {{ draw_barcode(x, y, height, module) }} in dots (PDF: draw_barcode(height_mm)); {{ draw_arabic(item_name_ar, x, y, height, max_width) }} draws Arabic as a bitmap, because label printer fonts cannot shape Arabic (PDF: draw_arabic(item_name_ar)); {{ fit(item_name, 30) }} cuts text to 30 characters.

Tags: {% if name %}, {% if not name %}, {% elif name %}, {% else %}, {% endif %}. Nothing else from Jinja, so the POS can print the same label offline. If the body does not use qty, the label is repeated.
